हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A fascinating documentary that explores how technology, data, and algorithms are reshaping human fate. From streaming platforms that predict our desires to AI systems that influence our choices, Destiny on Demand dives into a future where convenience meets control—and questions who’s really in charge of our destiny.
